title: 1870 Barcelona yellow fever epidemic
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1870 Barcelona yellow fever epidemic", at revision 1357861872, opens: "The 1870 Barcelona yellow fever epidemic was an epidemic that took place in the Spanish city of Barcelona in 1870." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q59466726, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "disease outbreak in Barcelona, Spain". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
